entities.summary: Assens is a town with a population of 5,952 on the west coast of the island of Funen on the eastern side of the Little Belt in central Denmark. By road, Assens is located 41.2 kilometres (25.6 mi) southwest of Odense, 34 kilometres (21 mi) northwest of Faaborg, and 33.34 kilometres (20.72 mi) southeast of Middelfart. Assens is the municipal seat of Assens Municipality in Region of Southern Denmark. It was the birthplace of sculptor Jens Adolf Jerichau who married the well-known portraitist Elisabeth Jerichau-Baumann; both artists' works are exhibited at the local art museum, Vestfyns Kunstmuseum.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Assens is notable for being the birthplace of sculptor Jens Adolf Jerichau and his wife Elisabeth Jerichau-Baumann, whose works are exhibited at Vestfyns Kunstmuseum. This local connection highlights the importance of Danish art and culture in the Classical era.
